heading: Sabis ɗin da wannan shafin zai iya amfani da su
stateDeny: Ba a ba da izini ba
stateAsk: Ba a zaɓa ba tukuna: zai fara tambaya
changedDeny: An adana: ba a ba {service} izini ba.
withdrawn: An janye duk zaɓuɓɓuka. Kowane sabis zai sake tambaya.
serviceSends_google_analytics: Yana ƙirga ziyara da shafukan da aka karanta. Google yana karɓar adireshin IP ɗinka kuma yana iya saita kukis.
serviceSends_youtube: Yana kunna bidiyo daga YouTube. Google yana karɓar adireshin IP ɗinka kuma yana iya saita kukis.
serviceSends_vimeo: Yana kunna bidiyo daga Vimeo. Vimeo yana karɓar adireshin IP ɗinka; wannan shafin yana roƙonsa kada ya bibiye ka.
serviceSends_google_maps: Yana nuna taswirori daga Google Maps. Google yana karɓar adireshin IP ɗinka kuma yana iya saita kukis.
serviceSends_speech: Idan burauzarka ba zai iya fahimtar magana a na'urarka ba, muryarka tana zuwa sabis ɗinsa na magana (Google, Apple ko Microsoft).
serviceSends_github: Yana nuna katunan ma'ajiya da sauran abubuwa daga GitHub. GitHub yana karɓar adireshin IP ɗinka kuma yana iya saita kukis.
serviceSends_webstatus: Yana nuna alamomin tallafin burauza na Baseline daga webstatus.dev, wani aikin Google Chrome. Google yana karɓar adireshin IP ɗinka.
serviceSends_aframe: Yana loda ɗakin karatu na A-Frame daga aframe.io don nuna yanayin 3D. aframe.io yana karɓar adireshin IP ɗinka.
serviceSends_embed: Yana nuna abubuwa daga {host}. {host} yana karɓar adireshin IP ɗinka kuma yana iya saita kukis.
